title: Section 781 Hemp & CBD: FDA Regulatory Framework & Enforcement
excerpt: Section 781 of the FD&C Act, enacted November 2025, rewrites the federal definition of hemp with a total THC standard and a 0.4 mg per container cap -- threatening 95% of existing hemp-derived cannabinoid products by November 2026. FDA missed its February 2026 guidance deadline, leaving the $30B industry in regulatory limbo.
seo_title: Hemp CBD Regulation: FDA Section 781, State Laws & Enforcement | Policy Canary
seo_description: Comprehensive analysis of Section 781's impact on hemp and CBD products: total THC redefinition, 0.4 mg container cap, FDA's missed guidance deadline, congressional response bills, state patchwork, and enforcement trends against CBD companies.
